automatic_renewal.excerpt: This lease shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless Tenant provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior.
automatic_renewal.why_it_matters: Missing the 60-day window locks you into another full year.
automatic_renewal.plain_english: Your lease renews itself every year. Miss the deadline and you owe another year.
questions_to_ask: What is the exact date I must submit notice?
Does notice need to be certified mail?

early_termination.excerpt: Tenant shall be liable for all remaining rent plus a termination fee equal to three months rent and shall forfeit the security deposit.
early_termination.why_it_matters: Three penalties stack: remaining rent, a 3-month fee, and full deposit loss.
early_termination.plain_english: Breaking this lease costs remaining rent PLUS 3 months penalty PLUS your deposit.
questions_to_ask: Is the landlord required to re-rent the unit?

late_fees.excerpt: A late charge of $150 per day shall be assessed for each day rent remains unpaid after the 3rd.
late_fees.why_it_matters: Daily fees compound rapidly — one week late equals over $1,000.
late_fees.plain_english: If rent is late past the 3rd, you owe $150 for every single day it stays unpaid.
questions_to_ask: Is a daily late fee enforceable here?
Is there a maximum cap on total fees?

security_deposit.excerpt: Landlord may deduct any amounts deemed necessary at Landlord's sole discretion. Deposit returned within 90 days.
security_deposit.why_it_matters: Sole discretion gives landlord unchecked power over your deposit.
security_deposit.plain_english: The landlord alone decides what to keep from your deposit.
questions_to_ask: Will you provide itemized deductions with receipts?
Can we do a move-in walkthrough?

maintenance_repairs.excerpt: Tenant shall be responsible for all repairs including plumbing electrical HVAC and appliances regardless of cause.
maintenance_repairs.why_it_matters: Full repair liability exposes you to thousands in costs.
maintenance_repairs.plain_english: You pay for everything that breaks including heating and plumbing.
questions_to_ask: Does local law allow waiving landlord repair obligations?
Can we limit this to minor repairs?

landlord_entry.excerpt: Landlord may enter the premises at any time without prior notice to Tenant.
landlord_entry.why_it_matters: No-notice entry eliminates your privacy rights entirely.
landlord_entry.plain_english: Your landlord can walk in at any time without telling you first.
questions_to_ask: Will you agree to 24 hours notice in writing?

subletting.excerpt: Tenant may not sublet without prior written consent which may be withheld at Landlord's sole discretion.
subletting.why_it_matters: Landlord can refuse subletting for any reason.
subletting.plain_english: You cannot sublet your apartment and the landlord can say no for any reason.
questions_to_ask: Under what circumstances would you approve a sublease?
Can consent not be unreasonably withheld?

guest_restrictions.excerpt: No guest may stay more than two consecutive nights. Violation constitutes immediate grounds for eviction.
guest_restrictions.why_it_matters: Tying a short guest limit to immediate eviction is unusually aggressive.
guest_restrictions.plain_english: Guests can only stay 2 nights in a row. Exceed that and you can be evicted.
questions_to_ask: Does this apply to family or caregivers?
